title: Organiser v2 port scope
question: Recurring events, collections, and custom links will inherit the Honest Clubhouse / Organiser Hub style (like Your events). What should this build cover?

options.label: List pages + sidebar
options.thesis: Redesign the three catalogue pages under /organiser/v2 and point sidebar nav there.
options.viewport: Header + primary CTA, scannable row lists or compact panels, empty/error states—matching Your events.
options.risk: Drilldown/edit pages stay on legacy routes until a later pass.

options.label: Lists + drilldowns
options.thesis: Also restyle recurring-template and collection detail/edit screens in the same pass.
options.viewport: Catalogue pages plus deep edit flows for templates and collections.
options.risk: Much larger surface; custom-links stays a list/editor; longer build.

options.label: Lists only, keep old URLs in nav
options.thesis: Ship v2 pages at new routes but leave sidebar pointing at legacy /organiser/event/* for now.
options.viewport: New pages exist; you navigate by URL until nav is updated.
options.risk: Easy to miss the new surfaces in day-to-day use.
